_comment: Drop this file next to index.html / style.css / main.js, fill in your project's data, and that's the whole showcase. Every section except project+tagline is optional — sections with no data hide themselves.

project.name: your-project-name
project.tagline: One sharp sentence describing what this project does and why anyone should care.

hero._comment_visual_kinds: kind ∈ { image | video | iframe | code }. Omit the whole 'hero' object to skip the visual section.
hero.alt: A screenshot of your project doing something cool

highlights.title: First key thing
highlights.description: What it does in plain language. Two short sentences max.

highlights.title: Second key thing
highlights.description: Skip the marketing words. Concrete is better.

highlights.title: Third key thing
highlights.description: If a feature is obvious from the name, give a non-obvious detail instead.

quickstart._comment: Verbatim shell snippet. Don't bother escaping — JSON-quote handles it.

screenshots.caption: Caption explaining what we're looking at
